subject: reasoning
question:
A dice has its faces marked by letters S, O, V, E, L and C. Two positions of the same dice are shown in the given figures. Which face is opposite to face V?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e4a2e2227955f5ac7aa2c62b1ed7198d81fcbeb0a4c8653cf9c5d09abea47da.png]
solution:
Given:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b86098c9157da21050450c2fcca1897ffb31fd32168aca20f6eb4ecd036abf1.png] 

As C is common in both dice.

Moving clockwise from the Common letter C,

Opposite pairs.

O ⇔ E

S ⇔ L

The remaining letter is V, so

C ⇔V

Thus, the opposite face of** V is C.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
